Townhomes in Tsawwassen turn up in Pebble Hill, English Bluff, Tsawwassen Springs, Beach Grove, Tsawwassen Central, Boundary Bay and Cliff Drive.
Delta RS zoning covers the majority of detached lots. Land of Tsawwassen First Nation (Tsawwassen Commons/Shores) is leasehold per TFN rules, so check title type.
Strata ownership: examine the roof and envelope history, the depreciation report, parking rules and strata fees.
Delta School District 37 includes English Bluff, Beach Grove, Cliff Drive and Pebble Hill elementaries and South Delta Secondary; confirm catchment by address.
Hwy 17 ends at the BC Ferries terminal, Hwy 99 leads to Vancouver, and South Delta Exchange buses link up with the Bridgeport Canada Line.
Planning to buy or sell in Tsawwassen?

About Jared Gibbons
Which areas of Tsawwassen should I look at for townhomes?

Townhome areas include Pebble Hill, English Bluff, Tsawwassen Springs, Beach Grove, Tsawwassen Central, Boundary Bay and Cliff Drive. Home age, lot size and price point are not the same in each, so I match the pocket to your budget and your commute.
What schools serve Tsawwassen?

Delta School District 37 is the district for these townhomes, with South Delta Secondary and the English Bluff, Beach Grove, Cliff Drive and Pebble Hill elementaries. Catchments are address-based, so ask the district to name the specific school prior to purchase.
How is transit and commuting from Tsawwassen?
South Delta Exchange buses go to the Bridgeport Canada Line. For driving, Hwy 99 reaches Vancouver and Hwy 17 reaches the BC Ferries terminal.
What zoning rules affect townhomes in Tsawwassen?
Most detached lots here fall under Delta RS zones. TFN rules make Tsawwassen First Nation lands leasehold, Tsawwassen Commons/Shores included, so look at the title type.
What should I check before buying a townhome in Tsawwassen?
Strata title means reading the parking rules, strata fees, roof and envelope history and depreciation report closely. I go through each document with you before subjects are removed.
Are first-time buyer exemptions available in Tsawwassen?
Yes, qualifying buyers can use the federal FHSA along with the exemption BC gives First-Time Home Buyers from property transfer tax. Current thresholds are covered in my first-time buyer guide.
